Embassy Theatre, In Partnership with Silverback Films and GEAlive, Presents Our Planet Live in Concert

Fort Wayne, Ind. (October 27, 2022) – The Embassy Theatre is excited to present Our Planet Live in Concert on Friday, April 7, 2023 at 8:00 p.m. The Emmy Award®-winning Netflix documentary is now a live-in-concert experience accompanied by an orchestra, with a donation for each performance to benefit Our Planet producing partner organization World Wildlife Fund (WWF). Member pre-sale is currently active; tickets go on sale to the public on Friday, October 28 at 10 a.m.
The recipients of all three awards will be announced at Foellinger Foundation’s Annual Meeting on January 22, 2026. Learn more about the awards at foellinger.org/leadership-awards.

network.coverage_note: The Embassy Theatre is a historic performing arts venue and not an educational institution, therefore it does not have Erasmus+ partnerships or academic mobility programs.
